cancellation_summary: Cancellations or changes must be made at least 48 hours before the departure time for a full refund
meeting_point: Kewalo Basin Harbor Pier D, Slip 111: 1125 Ala Moana Blvd B1, Honolulu, HI 96814
description: Join us on a double-decker boat to experience the beauty of green sea turtles and Hawaiian reef fish. Enjoy scenic views along the coast of Waikiki and look out for Hawaiian spinner dolphins or humpback whales (in winter). This tour is perfect for swimmers of all levels, guided by a water safety-certified crew.
what_is_included:
- Round-trip transportation from Waikiki to Harbor
- Complimentary soft drinks
- Free snorkel gear rental
- Hula performance
- Original Tattoo sticker 
- Complimentary snack
- Water safety-certified crew
*Note: We do not accommodate specific food allergies. Guests are advised to bring their own food/snacks if needed.
itinerary:
- Stop 1: Snorkeling with green sea turtles and Hawaiian reef fish
- Stop 2: Scenic views of Waikiki coast
- Stop 3: Potential sightings of dolphins and humpback whales (seasonal)
highlights:
- Snorkel with green sea turtles and Hawaiian reef fish
- Potential dolphin and whale sightings
- Double-decker boat with wraparound seating
check_in_details: Check-in at Kewalo Basin Harbor 30 minutes before departure. Trolley transportation from Waikiki available.
what_to_bring:
- Swimsuit (arrive ready to jump into the ocean)
- Beach towel (oversized preferable)
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Sunglasses and hat
- Long-sleeve jacket or sweatshirt (in winter)
- Motion sickness medicine (take before leaving the hotel)
- Cash or card for beverages and purchases
special_requirements:
- Shoes are not allowed on the boat for safety. Storage is provided onboard. Clean reef shoes and grip socks are permitted.
- Limit belongings to one bag per group due to limited space
- Meals do not accommodate allergies; prepare your own food if necessary
- No outside alcoholic beverages allowed
restrictions:
- Children under 2 years old are not allowed
- Not wheelchair accessible
extras:
**Turtle-Sighting Guarantee Policy**
- The Turtle Guarantee allows free rebooking only; no refunds are given if no turtles are sighted.
- The captain will only designate a tour as a "no-turtle-sighting tour" if no guests on the tour spot a turtle. If even one guest sees a turtle, the tour will not qualify as a "no-turtle-sighting tour."
- If the captain determines that no turtle was sighted, you may rebook the “Turtles and You” tour for free until a turtle is seen.
- Free rebooking is only valid for tours with open seats, and specific dates or times cannot be guaranteed.
- Guests who cannot join another tour during their stay may redeem the Turtle Guarantee at any time within three years of the original tour date.
- Free rebooking applies only to the original guest(s) and cannot be transferred.
faqs:
- **Can I bring my own food?** Yes, especially if you have allergies as meals do not accommodate dietary restrictions.
- **Is snorkeling gear provided?** Yes, all necessary gear is provided for snorkeling.
- **Are marine life sightings guaranteed?** No, sightings of marine life such as dolphins and whales are not guaranteed.
